missing_claims.evidence: Picher Fig. 9 and Whole genome amplification Methods describe TthPrimPol de novo primers; random hexamers are a comparator. The Fig. 3a GTCC/T assay template and Dean 2001 random primers are not TruePrime WGA reagents.

missing_claims.evidence_update: 2026-10-17: resolved as mis-scoped by two readers (root round 20; agent-K-second-reader). missing_claims.claim: Ion Torrent library preparation, adapters and read layout for the Supplementary Fig. 2 purified-DNA sequencing
missing_claims.evidence: Supplementary Fig. 2 legend names Ion Torrent only; no kit, adapter, barcode or read-length detail was found in the article or supplements read. conclusion: Two independent readers checked the original Picher methods, supplements, vendor/predecessor sources and SRA SRP085855 metadata. The original purified-DNA and single-cell branches remain distinct; later V2 lysis and predecessor random primers are not assigned to the study. ENA confirms TruePrime WGA runs but supplies no library-construction protocol. Exact downstream NEBNext kit and adapter identity remain unresolved, so no absence is accepted.
